purpose: Pixel-art sampling written by @margoengine/exporters, read back by each target's own importer on this PC.
fixture: One quad with a 4-texel palette PNG whose own sampler is linear with mips; exported with pixelArt: true (glTF NEAREST/NEAREST) and pixelArt: {mipmaps: 'nearest', wrap: 'clamp'} (NEAREST/NEAREST_MIPMAP_NEAREST).

godot.note: The glTF sampler alone sets the material filter; Godot keeps the embedded image uncompressed RGBA8 (format 5) and still builds mips, which a NEAREST filter never samples.

unreal.interchangeOnly: NEAREST gives TF_NEAREST but keeps mips (TMGS_FROM_TEXTURE_GROUP) and lossy TC_DEFAULT; NEAREST_MIPMAP_NEAREST gives TF_DEFAULT (linear).

afterCreateUnrealPixelArtScript.persisted: Read back in a fresh editor process after save: identical.
afterCreateUnrealPixelArtScript.emptyPath: RuntimeError: No Texture2D at or under /Game/NoSuchFolder; pass the imported texture or its folder

unity.note: glTF files imported with glTFast take filters from the glTF samplers; the engine's Unity exact profile already enforces Point with no mips.
